instruction: A candid wedding photograph, medium shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. In an elegant indoor hotel lobby with potted plants and grey sofas in the background, the woman with curly hair in a white one-shoulder dress (R1) stands on the left, smiling as she looks at the woman in a white pantsuit (R2). The woman in a white pantsuit (R2) stands on the right, holding a bouquet of pink peonies and turning her head to look back at the woman in a white dress (R1) with a happy expression. The woman in a white dress (R1) keeps her left hand on the shoulder of the woman in a white pantsuit (R2). Soft, natural light fills the space, creating a warm and serene atmosphere with neutral tones.
